Refreshing iced tee and relaxing atmosphere
Jan 2020 • Solo
Really nice and calm place to enjoy iced tee between all the exploring you are propably doing while visiting Ho Chi Minh City. Sure, the prices are a bit steep for Vietnam, but the peach iced tea is amazing and the staff is exreamely accommodating. Plus they will compensate you for using the elevator if you decide to do so (I couldn't see the reason why) and offer you a free wife. Perfect spot for relaxing and reading a book between all the hustle. And once you get hungry, just check one of the restaurants at Cafe Apartments. Oh and forgot to mention, they have an air conditioning.

Disappointing attitude
Sep 2019 • Friends
Very disappointed with the attitude of the ladies at the cashier. Nine of us went in and ordered 7 cups of tea because one couple wanted to share. But we were told that’s not allowed. We asked why and the response was each patron must ordered a cuppa because their rental is very high ... 🙄🙄 .... and the final response was (when we tried to explained that a couple wanted to share), the cashier told us that since we have not paid, we can cancel our order and leave ..... 😏 how very professional !!!

Great!
Feb 2019 • Couples
Visited this place a couple of times during our stay in Saigon. Located on the 7th floor and with a balcony you get a nice view overlocking the busy streets while enjoying your tea. They have a good selection of hot tea and icetea, we only tried the icetea which was amazing! The cinnamon and lemon tea was probably my favorite out of the four different teas we tried, it kind of tasted like cinnamonbuns (in a good way!). Definitly worth a visit.
